text:
Sophia Rivera: Hi folks, excited to join! Followed the k8s onboarding but `kubectl config get-contexts` only shows 'default'. The guide mentions redwood-dev. Need a dev namespace (sophia-dev) to test local previews. Who should I ping?

Carlos Nguyen: welcome Sophia :wave: Quick checks: are you hitting Okta SSO? run `redwood-sso login --okta` and then `kubectl config view --minify --raw` and paste the contexts block (sanitized).

Sophia Rivera: ran the SSO flow. Sanitized contexts: `contexts:\n- context:\n    cluster: redwood-dev\n    user: sophia@redwood.ai\n  name: redwood-dev`

Riley Park: that user looks like the raw email not the Okta exec user. Our connector should produce `okta:sophia@redwood.ai`. @onboard-bot can you trigger a directory sync for sophia@redwood.ai?

onboard-bot: Directory sync requested for sophia@redwood.ai (job: sync-2026-11-03-07).

Carlos Nguyen: while we wait, try `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n sophia-dev`. If it errors with "You must be logged in" the exec plugin wasn't written. If it says "no" that's OK until RBAC applied.

Sophia Rivera: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n sophia-dev` -> "error: You must be logged in to the server (the server has asked for the client to provide credentials)"

Riley Park: sync finished, creating namespace `sophia-dev` and a RoleBinding `rb-sophia-dev-edit` granting edit to `okta:sophia@redwood.ai`. Applying now.

Riley Park: done. Try `redwood-sso login --okta` again and then `kubectl get pods -n sophia-dev`. Also `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=sophia-dev` to avoid `-n` every time.

Sophia Rivera: re-ran SSO and now `kubectl get pods -n sophia-dev` -> "no resources found". I can list! port-forward to my service works. Thanks so much.

Carlos Nguyen: welcome aboard. We'll add a short note to the onboarding doc: if contexts show a plain email run `redwood-sso doctor` and request a directory sync; typical propagation delay ~30-90s.

Sophia Rivera: great — one more q: later I'll need a CI service account to run e2e tests. Do I request that in #eng-infra?

Riley Park: yep, open in #eng-infra with the SA name and required verbs. We prefer namespaced SAs for dev work.

Sophia Rivera: perfect, thanks everyone :tada:
